index.method: Within each caseId/owner only, collect pausedCaptureStart/captureStart/samples/captureEnd successful subject paint histories. Collapse repeated copies of one renderSequence into a read-only comparison index after checking x/phase/renderKind agree, sort by original sequence, then compare consecutive successful same-kind paints using exact numeric equality. This is an index over repeated history snapshots, not a repair of accepted clocks or media.

index.outcomeFields: captureStart/samples/captureEnd.body.renderHistory[].x and jointLocomotion.phase, with finite articulatedWalkPhase fallback only when available
index.predicate: currentRoot!==previousRoot && currentPhase===previousPhase; a finite unchanged root alone falsifies the conjunction even if phase is absent

The matching jointLocomotion audit phase is captured from that runtime; v100HumanWalkPhase is Number(runtime.locomotionPhase)||0.
